About the Portal
 

This is the Official Web-Portal of the Government of Himachal Pradesh, India, designed, developed and hosted by National Informatics Centre (NIC), Himachal Pradesh State Centre. NIC is a premier ICT Organisation of the Government of India under the aegis of Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

The objective behind the Portal is to provide a single window access to the information and services being provided by the Himachal Pradesh Government for the citizens and other stakeholders. An attempt has been made through this Portal to provide comprehensive, accurate, reliable and one stop source of information about Himachal Pradesh and its various facets. Links at various places, too, have been provided to other State Government Departments/ Organizations Portals/ Websites.

The content in this Portal is the result of a collaborative efforts of various Himachal Pradesh Government Departments, Corporations, Commissions, Boards and other Organisations at the State/ District level. It is our endeavour to continue the enhancement and enrichment of this Portal in terms of content coverage, design and technology on a regular basis and suggestions from users will be welcome.

Disclaimer: The contents of this website are informative only and for the benefit of the public. Neither NIC nor Government of Himachal Pradesh is liable for any inadvertent or typing errors.
